commit.message:
ci(release): wait for lagging provenance before failing the publish

npm serves a version's SLSA provenance minutes after its manifest, and
the verify step only waited for missing manifests. 3.17.0, 3.17.1 and
3.17.2 all went red on a package whose attestation appeared shortly
after, each needing a manual re-verify.

A published package whose provenance is not readable yet is now
retried in the same 10-minute settle window, and reported broken only
if it is still missing at the deadline.

Also re-check late-appearing packages with their full record: they were
retried as { name, version } only, which dropped releasedAtHead and
skipped their provenance check entirely.
